events.title: Night Feast
events.description: A multi-sensory arts and culinary festival held at the Powerhouse, featuring various live music performances alongside food and immersive installations. It serves as a communal hub for Brisbane's cultural scene throughout the week.

events.title: DICE (AUS)
events.description: Australian indie-rock band DICE perform live at The Tivoli, known for their high-energy surf-rock sound. Expect a classic club gig experience in a historic venue.

events.title: Best Of The Bee Gees (AUS)
events.description: A tribute show celebrating the iconic discography of the Bee Gees, featuring professional musicians performing hits from the 60s, 70s, and 80s. This is a seated/standing performance aimed at fans of pop and disco history.

events.title: Bachelor Girl: Waiting for the Day Redux Tour 2026
events.description: Australian pop duo Bachelor Girl return to perform their classic material on their 2026 tour. Hosted at The Triffid, this gig promises an intimate atmosphere for fans of 90s Australian pop music.
